{{Quote|An interagency group that coordinates with the Imperial military to undergo infiltration and undercover surveillance.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] describes the Investigations branch, ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''|<ref name="IHB">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>}}
'''Investigations''' was a branch of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] whose agent and officers had direct links to military forces pre-approved by both the local [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] or [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]], and the [[Select Committee/Legends|Select Committee]]. Investigations officers could appropriate military assets when the need arose during the course of their duty to better counter legitimate [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] threats. The majority of Investigations officers were taken from [[Surveillance (Imperial Security Bureau)/Legends|Surveillance]], along with those personnel from the [[Department of Modification]] looking to use their talents in new ways. Investigations agents enjoyed a large amount of success employing military assets, forcing many Rebel bases on populated worlds to be evacuated. Only on backwater worlds, where convincing cover identities were rare, did they fail to take advantage of this connection.<ref name="ISB" />

Investigations agents developed a grudging respect for the Alliance and their counterparts within its intelligence service. The struggle between [[Mar Barezz]] and [[Tay Vanis]], and [[Huorne]] and [[Parl]]'s efforts against [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]], were well-known in intelligence circles, taking on legendary status.<ref name="ISB" />
